node-1.label: Patient experienced blurred vision and progressive visual impairment in the affected eye

node-2.label: A 78-year-old woman underwent DMEK surgery; four weeks postoperatively, mild opacification in the graft-host interface was observed, visual acuity rehabilitation stopped at 20/50, graft was attached, and stromal thickness returned to normal (552 μm)

node-3.label: Six months later, the patient complained of blurred vision; physical examination revealed graft detachment caused by a paracentral opaque mass, enlargement of the abnormality, and pseudohypopyon formation

node-4.label: At 28 months follow-up, visual impairment had increased
